Amplitude
By Harmonix Music Systems
In the early 2000s, Harmonix created the cult-classic game Amplitude. Now it's
time for a reboot, complete with updated visuals and a new soundtrack. It's
ending soon, but there's still time to bring back a revamped Amplitude for the
future.

 E$2.00 Summer Concerts at Crooked Lane Farm

$2.00 Summer Concerts at Crooked Lane Farm
By Mary Jo Schmid at Crooked Lane Farm
North Dakota's Crooked Lane Farm wants to host a concert series this
summer. It's a chance to hear some great folk music while helping preserve the
melodic tradition of the prairie. We're all about summertime jams on a farm.
Oh, and did we mention these are $2 concerts?

Meet OTTO - The Hackable GIF Camera
By Next Thing Co.
A cute little camera that makes GIFs? Yup, that's OTTO. Just point, shoot, and
crank to animate. Sounds cool, right? It gets even cooler when you hack it with
Raspberry Pi.
